title: Piven Theatre

services.name: Acting Classes
services.desc: For over 50 years, Piven Theatre Workshop has provided a space for artists to gather, learn, grow, and create. Acting classes at Piven provide people of all ages and backgrounds with the tools to express themselves. Education and mentorship are at the heart of what we do. We are, at our core, storytellers and we strive to create a space for people to share their unique voices and experiences. In our acting classes, students develop their acting technique as well as essential skills like strong communication, critical thinking, and problem solving.
